messages.subject: Polaris - cap table and consideration allocation
messages.plaintextBody:
Nathan,

The pre-completion cap table is finalised - 1,000,000 ordinary shares, with Helena at 48%, Marcus 27%, the family trust 9%, Camberwell Growth Capital 14% and management 2%. The equity consideration of £32.8m allocates pro rata. The figures tie to Schedule 1 of the SPA. Shout if you'd like the working file.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0044
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
